sentences.en: Many of their wetland habitats are being affected by mining.
sentences.zh: 许多他们的湿地栖息地正受到采矿的影响。

sentences.en: There’s a game called Minecraft that is about mining.
sentences.zh: 有一种叫做《我的世界》的游戏，是关于采矿的。

sentences.en: Renewable energy and deep-sea mining also offer opportunities for investment.
sentences.zh: 可再生能源和深海采矿也为投资提供了机会。
